source.title: Lumentum FY2026 Form 10-K
source.readingScope: Targeted capital-bridge review; not a complete new operating or employee-claim appraisal.

reportedFacts.cappedCallAccounting: Equity-classified; not recognized as a separate balance-sheet asset.
reportedFacts.principalSettlement: Cash for every note series; only excess conversion value may settle in shares.

analyticalTreatment.formula: (operating EV + 2738.4 cash + 200 capped calls - 7607.2 note fair value - 92.8 term principal) / 91.5
notes: The adjustment above principal is not a pure option value. No separate convertible shares, coupons or historical capped-call premiums are charged.
The term-loan face proxy is retained. The approx 91.5 denominator is a common-equivalent allocation, not fully diluted fair value.
Both dated financing proxies remain fixed across operating Monte Carlo trials; changes in internally estimated operating value do not reprice them.

correction.supersedesInterpretation: The frozen register described 757.8 conversion requests as a simple subset of June note principal.
correction.correctedInterpretation: 757.8 is cumulative through August 14 and includes 519.4 already cash-settled during FY2026. Neither the total nor the 238.4 difference is an additional verified June claim.

limits: The capped-call amount and preferred common-equivalent denominator are approximate.
This is not a self-consistent intrinsic option valuation, complete equity appraisal or current October price.
Cash availability and the June-to-October settlement/cash/share roll-forward remain unresolved.
AAOI and NBIS renewed cases remain operating-only; no partial fair-value range is introduced.

savedDraftPolicy.freshDraft: Seed the sourced June note adjustment and capped-call credit.
savedDraftPolicy.legacyDraft: Preserve all entered values. Make an absent old note adjustment explicitly null and absent old capped-call credit zero. Never infer that unknown means zero.
savedDraftPolicy.explicitLoad: Load reviewed June bridge values changes only these two LITE inputs and its review marker. Full prior-draft Undo remains available.
savedDraftPolicy.malformedDraft: Retain for recovery; do not substitute source numbers.
